description: This file defines the class TaxwareUTL, which manages interactions with the Taxware third-party taxation system, including preparing data files, processing responses, and handling tax calculations and adjustments within the order processing context.

classes.name: TaxwareUTL
classes.description: A utility class for interacting with the Taxware tax calculation system, managing data file creation, processing, and adjustments related to tax calculations for orders.

methods.name: TaxwareUTL
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data files and loads necessary libraries.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the order items and shipping information, generates data files, calls the tax calculation, and processes the results.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping amount for the transaction.

methods.name: getItemAdjustments
methods.description: Returns the list of adjustments applied to individual items.

methods.name: getOrderAdjustments
methods.description: Returns the list of order-level adjustments.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes data files and loads the native library for tax calculations.

methods.name: makeItemData
methods.description: Adds static and address data to a record, preparing it for tax processing.

methods.name: addStaticData
methods.description: Fills in static properties from configuration into the record.

methods.name: addAddresses
methods.description: Adds address data to the record from the provided address value object.

methods.name: createDataFile
methods.description: Creates a DataFile object from resource configuration.

methods.name: loadLib
methods.description: Loads the native tax common library.

methods.name: taxCalc
methods.description: Calls the native tax calculation function and returns the response buffer.

methods.name: callTaxware
methods.description: Invokes the JNI method to perform tax calculations.

methods.name: checkFields
methods.description: Checks that all required fields (shipping amount, address, items) are set before processing.

methods.name: processOutFile
methods.description: Processes the response buffer from the tax calculation, updates adjustments, and verifies data consistency.
